entities.name: Peugeot Hoggar (coupé utility)
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Peugeot Hoggar is a coupé utility produced by Peugeot as a variant of their front-engined, front wheel drive Peugeot 206+ for the Brazilian and South American market. It was produced by Usine PSA of Porto Real, Brazil from 2010 to 2014.
